numbers.q: How does Kallo work out the numbers?
numbers.a: It splits what you wrote into single foods, matches each one against USDA and FAO food data, and estimates the portion from your words.

weigh.q: Do I have to weigh my food?
weigh.a: No. Eyeball it the way you would tell a friend. If you do weigh something, type the grams and Kallo uses them.

web.q: Is it on the web too?
web.a: Yes. The iPhone app and the web app share one account, so a meal logged on one shows up on the other.
